description: Creates the secure Mollie checkout for the chosen REP27 plan with the buyer's company, country, contact name and email, and returns the payment link. Payment happens on Mollie's page, never in the chat.

billing.description: yearly, or monthly only for GPSR responsible-person plans
billing.title: Billing

company.description: Legal name of the buying company
company.title: Company

country.description: Country where the company is established
country.title: Country

currency.description: Currency to pay in: EUR, USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, NZD, CHF, CZK, JPY or NOK (ECB rate)
currency.title: Currency

email.description: Email of the buyer contact, as given by the user
email.title: Email

lang.description: Language code for the answer (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, it, es, fr, de, pt, nl, pl, ja, zh)
lang.title: Lang

name.description: Full name of the buyer contact, as given by the user
name.title: Name

plan.description: Plan key as returned by get_plans: base, standard, multi (gdpr) or rp-solo, rp-brand, rp-house (gpsr)
plan.title: Plan

service.description: gdpr = GDPR Art. 27 representative, gpsr = GPSR Art. 16 EU responsible person
service.title: Service

territory.description: Territory for the GDPR representative: eu, uk or both
territory.title: Territory

vat.description: EU VAT number if the company has one (reverse charge, no VAT)
vat.title: Vat

name: create_checkout
title: Create secure checkout
